verdict.rationale: Ashby's integrations page says it offers out-of-the-box integrations with job boards, which glancingly touches distributing postings to boards. Nothing shows one posting fanning out to LinkedIn, Indeed, or aggregators, or any sponsored-post management inside the ATS. The careers-page API and job-posting webhooks are developer building blocks, not job-board distribution, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: named LinkedIn/Indeed/aggregator distribution, one-posting fan-out workflow, sponsored/promoted post management and budgeting in-app, any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, one posting fans out to the job boards — LinkedIn, Indeed, and the aggregators — with sponsored-post management from inside the ATS

citations.quote: Streamline your recruiting operations with 250+ out-of-the-box integrations into the platform, assessment, job boards, sourcing, interviewing, and post-hire tools you want to use.
